selection: Disc, hammerhead, kite, claws, needle, batwing and beetle chosen over recolors of existing crescent/six-shield/porcelain forms. Cannon kits are coherent single asset sheets cropped into 3 runtime sprites. Background motifs differ from existing planets, flowers, geodes and vaults; quiet center required.
